decision: Selected the centroid of Clark County Assessor parcel 123-28-601-034 (18.0 assessor acres; owner of record Novva Las Vegas LLC; tax district 254, North Las Vegas) as the campus locator of Novva's Las Vegas data center at 6115 Nicco Way.

12328601034.owner_of_record: NOVVA LAS VEGAS L L C (organisation; Accela owner layer, owner status A, primary owner), from local clark-accela-owner-points-novva.json

selected_properties.other_owner_records: The Accela owner layer lists two further APNs for the same owner, 123-28-601-016 and 123-28-601-030, with no point, address or city; the current Assessor parcel layer returns no polygon for either (queried in the same request), so only 123-28-601-034 is used.
selected_properties.layer: Clark County Assessor/Layers MapServer layer 1 (parcels), queried by APN with outSR=4326

computed.method: Polygon returned with outSR=4326; centroid computed in EPSG:32611 (WGS 84 / UTM 11N) and returned to WGS84; an EPSG:5070 cross-check gives the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: Novva's Las Vegas page in its version modified 2 July 2026 (Internet Archive copy of 14 July 2026) shows 'Novva Data Centers – Las Vegas 6115 Nicco Way, Las Vegas, NV 89115'; the 31 August 2026 version describes the same 275,000 sq ft, 100 MW North Las Vegas facility.

The Clark County air-quality stationary-source register (AQM/StationarySource map layer) lists source 18179, 'NOVVA DATA CENTERS' (company NOVVA LAS VEGAS LLC), source type DATA CENTER, at 6115 NICCO WAY; its point (-115.0487710, 36.2718559) lies inside parcel 123-28-601-034, 39.9 m from the centroid.
The Clark County Accela owner layer gives NOVVA LAS VEGAS L L C as the active primary owner of parcel 123-28-601-034 (city NORTH LAS VEGAS); its point coincides with the parcel centroid.

Novva's own structured-data GeoCoordinates for the page (-115.0478565, 36.2711640) lie 7.1 m outside the parcel's eastern boundary (106.0 m from the centroid), consistent with a point placed on the Nicco Way frontage; it is not used as the locator.
unresolved: Individual buildings are not located; the point represents the 18-acre parcel that holds the campus (Novva describes a 16-acre campus and 20 acres of land area).
The county publishes no positional accuracy for parcel polygons.
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping entry, pending fragment, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km; the nearest Atlas site is DataBank LAS1 at 7185 Pollock Drive, about 25.1 km south-west.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output from the county service (outSR=4326)
